Regulated sectors additionally require a named critical-infrastructure officer designation and a documented accountability statement for protected health information.

artifacts.name: Board & Executive Approval Records and Minutes
artifacts.description: Board resolutions and top-management meeting minutes evidencing approval of the governance framework, the organisational and IT structure, the roles and responsibilities document and the authorization matrix, plus minutes showing ongoing executive review of cyber and technology risk. Must show the approving body, date, and the specific item approved, and include evidence of cross-functional participation where required.

artifacts.name: Job Descriptions with Security Accountabilities
artifacts.description: Job descriptions for the roles carrying security, privacy and technology risk duties, including the CISO and IT leadership, stating the authorities delegated and the specific security responsibilities held. Must align with the RACI matrix and cover the incident response and risk management roles named there.

artifacts.name: Governance Framework, Policies & Standards
artifacts.description: The approved enterprise technology and cybersecurity governance framework and its supporting policies, including the governance responsibility model, the mapping of technology governance to corporate governance, transparency and oversight procedures, procurement policy, documentation standards, and the policies allocating information security responsibility and coordinating it across the organisation. Regulated entities also require a mapping of the framework to applicable local regulation.

artifacts.name: Segregation of Duties & Conflict-of-Interest Review
artifacts.description: The segregation of duties matrix for key security and technology functions, plus the documented review confirming assigned roles do not create conflicts of interest — for example independence between those operating a control and those assuring it.

artifacts.name: Role Acknowledgement & Awareness Communication Records
artifacts.description: Evidence that assigned individuals know and accepted their responsibilities: signed role acknowledgements, signed confidentiality agreements, leadership communications logs, awareness communications informing personnel of the allocation of security responsibilities, and records of compliance with assigned procurement or governance duties.

artifacts.name: Periodic Review Records of the Accountability Structure
artifacts.description: Records of the scheduled reviews of the governance framework, organisational structure, RACI matrix and supporting policies, naming the reviewer, the review date and any changes made, including the change-control records and approvals for revisions to governance documentation. Frameworks differ on cadence, so evidence should show review at least annually and on triggering events such as reorganisation.

artifacts.name: Management & Board Reporting Pack
artifacts.description: The reports through which accountable executives discharge their duty upward: CISO reports and KPIs, senior management reports to the board on technology and cyber risk developments, executive cyber briefing records, the integrated governance reporting pack and governance oversight records. Must show reporting occurred on a regular cycle and reached the board or its delegated committee.

artifacts.name: Strategy & Risk Tolerance Statements
artifacts.description: The approved security strategy document, the top-management commitment statement, and the documented risk tolerance statement (including AI risk tolerance where applicable) with their approval records — the statements that set the boundaries within which accountable teams are empowered to act.

artifacts.name: Resource Allocation, Staffing & Competence Records
artifacts.description: Evidence that accountable teams are actually resourced and trained: resource allocation records for the management system, resource requirements analysis for continuity and recovery (including alternate site and technology recovery requirements), and staffing and training records for the risk, legal and security functions.

artifacts.name: Program & Project Governance Records
artifacts.description: The program management methodology and standards, program charters with business cases and authorization records, program plans showing milestones and resource allocation, and status reports with benefits realisation tracking — evidencing that accountability extends to change programs, not only steady-state operations.

artifacts.name: AI Governance Accountability Records
artifacts.description: Artifacts evidencing that AI-specific accountability is assigned and exercised: implementation records demonstrating the AI governance outcomes are met, the AI system decommissioning and deactivation procedure, and documented demonstration of model validity and reliability with generalizability limitations stated and an owner assigned.

artifacts.name: Third-Party & Outsourcing Governance Records
artifacts.description: The outsourcing governance framework, the executed third-party service agreements that carry responsibilities for continuity and recovery services, and board or committee oversight evidence for outsourced arrangements — showing accountability is retained internally for externally delivered services.

GOV-04.1.notes: 111 asks collapse to 15 artifacts. The single attached connector (Rippling) can produce reporting lines and job-title data, so the org chart and job description items are hybrid; everything else is human-authored governance documentation. The largest cluster by far (21 entries) is the same roles-and-responsibilities matrix restated per framework and per function (AI, BC, cyber, IT, procurement, incident, CII) — one master RACI with function-specific views satisfies all of them.

artifacts.name: Accountability Charter
artifacts.description: The charter or board resolution assigning ultimate accountability for security governance, risk and compliance to a named senior role, with the terms of reference documenting it and the formal designation records. PISF 2026 requires the accountability to rest with the head of the entity or a delegate; SBP ETGRMF requires the enterprise technology governance framework to be board-approved with the resolution signed by attending directors.

artifacts.name: Security Function Appointment Records
artifacts.description: The appointment letter or order designating the security function lead with the stated reporting line, the job description and credentials for the role, and the deployment order confirming full-time assignment where required.

artifacts.name: Independence and Conflict-of-Interest Evidence
artifacts.description: The board resolution establishing the security lead's independence from the technology function, the conflict of interest policy articulating it, the assessment confirming no conflict with IT or ICT, the reporting line diagram, and the job description showing independence from the technology executive.

artifacts.name: Governance Structure Diagram
artifacts.description: The organisational chart showing the reporting chain from board through its committees to the technology and security executives, the enterprise-wide organisation chart with headcount and functional teams, and the documented rationale showing the structure reflects the organisation's size, scale and business objectives.

artifacts.name: Function and Role Charters
artifacts.description: The charters or terms of reference for each major function and leadership position detailing scope and responsibilities, the security committee charter with member qualifications and coordination procedures, and the security group charter.

artifacts.name: Roles and Responsibilities Matrix
artifacts.description: The RACI matrix for key security functions, the authorisation matrix defining what each role may decide, the roles and responsibilities document expressed in terms of desired outcomes, the job descriptions with defined authorities, the segregation of duties matrix, and the staff acknowledgement records confirming they accept their roles. PISF 2026 requires top-management approval of the documented roles.

artifacts.name: Structure Approval and Review Records
artifacts.description: The board or committee approval of the organisational structure, the records of periodic reviews confirming it remains aligned with the governance framework, the benchmarking records confirming it remains commensurate with the organisation's profile, and the framework review log tracking each review with reviewers, changes and re-approval.

artifacts.name: Governance Oversight Minutes
artifacts.description: The minutes evidencing the accountable person or board exercising oversight, the board and senior management minutes on cyber security, the executive briefing and drill records, the committee meeting minutes, and the records of the accountable officer exercising their oversight function.

artifacts.name: Cyber Governance Accountability Matrix
artifacts.description: The charter establishing cyber governance at board or senior management level with the RACI matrix establishing a clear chain of accountability for cyber security actions.

artifacts.name: Management Commitment Evidence
artifacts.description: The evidence of management commitment to the governance arrangement — the signed commitment statement, the resource allocation records provisioning the function, and the log of leadership communications on its importance.

artifacts.name: Top-Management Meeting Records
artifacts.description: The minutes of executive or management meetings where management system performance, decisions and continual improvement are discussed and decided, evidencing the chain of command operates rather than only exists on paper.

artifacts.name: Incident Response Authority Records
artifacts.description: The matrix of incident response roles with their authority and dependency levels, and the current incident response team roster, establishing who may direct action during an incident.

artifacts.name: Governance Responsibility Model
artifacts.description: The documented governance responsibility model with the records demonstrating it operates in the environment covered.

artifacts.name: AI Governance Accountability Records
artifacts.description: The RACI matrix defining AI risk management roles, the approved organisational policies and procedures, the documented AI risk tolerance statement with its approval records, the implementation records evidencing the outcome within the AI lifecycle, and the periodic review records.

artifacts.name: Policy Implementation Monitoring
artifacts.description: The compliance monitoring reports and policy implementation records evidencing that the accountable function's directions are followed across the organisation.

GOV-04.2.notes: 81 asks across 11 frameworks. The recurring demand is that accountability sits with a named person at a stated level, independent of the function being overseen; the artifacts are grouped by the instrument that establishes it — appointment, charter, org chart, minutes.

artifacts.name: Performance Monitoring Framework and Metric Definitions
artifacts.description: The documented framework defining what is measured, how, against what target and by whom. COBIT expects KPI definitions with conformance monitoring against target achievement; MAS TRM and QCB expect key risk indicator definitions with thresholds and a cyber resilience indicator catalogue with baseline and current measurements; ISO 22301 scopes it to BCMS monitoring and measurement procedures; NDMO requires an approved standard covering data governance KPIs.

artifacts.name: Performance Dashboards and Scorecards
artifacts.description: The dashboards and scorecards reporting measured performance with trend analysis: governance KPI dashboards, technology risk metrics, IT value delivery measures, cybersecurity KPI dashboards and security metrics. NIS2 expects the cybersecurity measures to be reported to the management body; SBP ETGRMF expects IT value delivery to cover benefit realisation, cost savings and SLA attainment.

artifacts.name: Governance Body Reporting and Minutes
artifacts.description: The reporting packages tabled to the board, audit committee and management, with the minutes recording deliberation and decision. COBIT expects governance decisions to be minuted; SBP ETGRMF expects a consolidated performance management report to the audit committee with submission records; ISO 42001 expects executive minutes where AIMS performance and continual improvement are decided; NIS2 expects management-body briefing records on cybersecurity effectiveness.

artifacts.name: Periodic Effectiveness Review and Corrective Actions
artifacts.description: The periodic assessment of whether the control or governance programme is achieving its objectives, with corrective action plans and follow-up tracking. COBIT expects governance effectiveness review reports; SBP ETGRMF expects effectiveness assessments evaluating programme impact on business lines and a documented monitoring procedure; ISO 22301 expects BCMS effectiveness evaluation records; NIST AI RMF expects ongoing monitoring and periodic review of AI risk management.

artifacts.name: IT Strategy and Business Alignment Documentation
artifacts.description: The IT strategic plan aligned to business strategy with current-state and target-state architecture, gap analysis with prioritised initiatives, the traceability matrix linking each IT initiative to a business objective with its value metric and risk rating, the resource management plan, and the register of approved technology plans and policies with owner and review date.

artifacts.name: AI Risk Metrics and Measurement Methodology
artifacts.description: Defined AI risk metrics with their measurement methodology, AI impact assessments, the RACI matrix for AI risk management roles, the incident or error register, stakeholder engagement log, and the demonstration of validity and reliability with generalizability limitations documented.

artifacts.name: AIMS Leadership Commitment Evidence
artifacts.description: The signed top-management commitment statement for the AI management system aligned to strategic direction, the log of leadership communications on its importance, and the record of budget, human and infrastructure resources allocated to it.

artifacts.name: Application Security and Incident Response Metrics
artifacts.description: Documented application security metrics and incident response metrics, or the configuration evidence standing in their place, with the records demonstrating each is implemented in the cloud environment.

artifacts.name: Independent Assurance and Testing Reports
artifacts.description: Internal audit plan and schedule, continuous monitoring programme documentation, security control testing results, penetration testing and vulnerability assessment reports, and security audit findings — the independent corroboration of what the dashboards report.

artifacts.name: Data Governance and Quality Evidence
artifacts.description: The approved data management and personal data protection strategy, data quality profiling reports, data value realisation records, service level agreements for data quality and reference/master data, retention schedules, and the organisational artifacts (role mandates, RACI, committee charters) that carry accountability for them.

artifacts.name: Business Process Control Documentation
artifacts.description: Business process control documentation and procedures, information processing validation and integrity check records, error and exception handling logs with corrective action, and the segregation of duties matrix with access privilege records.

artifacts.name: Governance Body Charters and Composition
artifacts.description: The IT governance charter and framework documentation, governance structure organisation charts with roles and responsibilities, board charter, composition and independence declarations, and committee structure documentation for audit and risk committees.

artifacts.name: Accountability, Awareness and Reporting Channels
artifacts.description: The accountability framework, performance evaluation criteria including security responsibilities, incentive documentation tied to control objectives, security policy library and metrics dashboard, awareness session logs and materials, RACI and role assignments, asset ownership register, and the whistleblower or anonymous reporting mechanism.

artifacts.name: Stakeholder Communication and Satisfaction Evidence
artifacts.description: The stakeholder communication strategy and plans, IT governance reporting templates, and stakeholder satisfaction survey results used to judge whether the governance programme is meeting the needs it exists to serve.

GOV-05.notes: 123 asks across 11 frameworks. Separated into the framework that defines measures, the reporting that carries them, the governance bodies that receive them, and the independent assurance that corroborates them — the raw list interleaves all four.

artifacts.name: KPI Framework and Definitions
artifacts.description: The documented framework defining each KPI, its target, measurement method, data source, owner and its linkage to organisational objectives. SBP ETGRMF requires targets and their rationale to be recorded and expects problem-management KPIs (MTTR, recurrence rate, closure time) specifically; ISO 22301 scopes this to BCMS effectiveness; NDMO requires an approved policy or standard defining the KPIs per data domain.

artifacts.name: KPI Dashboard and Measurement Reports
artifacts.description: The dashboard and periodic reports showing measured performance against target, with trend. NDMO expects one per data domain covering targets, measurements and review records; SBP Cloud expects a cloud KPI/KRI pack showing CSP performance and cloud risk submitted to the IT steering committee; SOC 2 expects security KPI dashboards tied to control objectives; ISO 22301 expects performance analysis reports.

artifacts.name: Periodic KPI Review Records
artifacts.description: Records of the periodic reviews of the KPI set itself: reviewer, date, whether targets remain appropriate, corrective actions raised and their follow-up. NDMO requires reviewer, date and corrective actions explicitly; NIST AI RMF expects the review to cover the AI measurement approach and its documented limitations.

artifacts.name: Board and Committee Reporting Pack
artifacts.description: The management information pack submitted to the board or steering committee, with the board-approved policy defining its format and contents, the submission log with receipt evidence, and the minutes evidencing review and discussion. SBP Cloud requires the committee's terms of reference to be amended to include cloud outsourcing governance and that amendment approved.

artifacts.name: Governance Body Charters and Composition
artifacts.description: Charters and composition documentation for the board and its committees (audit, risk, IT steering), independence declarations, and the minutes showing internal control oversight in operation.

artifacts.name: Data Management Strategy and Plan
artifacts.description: The approved data management and personal data protection strategy and plan that the data-domain KPIs measure against, together with the compliance audit reports and assessment records evidencing adherence.

artifacts.name: Data Quality and Catalog Evidence
artifacts.description: Data quality profiling reports and issue-resolution records showing trends against target, plus the metadata repository or data catalog export and the master/reference data register with golden-record definitions and stewardship records.

artifacts.name: AI Risk Metrics and Measurement Methodology
artifacts.description: The defined AI risk metrics with their measurement methodology, the context documentation covering intended purposes, and the demonstration of validity and reliability with generalizability limitations stated. NIST AI RMF expects the limitations of the measurement approach to be documented, not only the results.

artifacts.name: Independent Assurance and Testing Reports
artifacts.description: The internal audit plan and schedule, continuous monitoring programme documentation, security control testing results, and penetration testing and vulnerability assessment reports that independently corroborate the reported KPIs.

artifacts.name: Supplier Performance Evidence
artifacts.description: The dashboard of defined supplier compliance and cybersecurity KPIs, together with the reports from periodic supplier reviews and risk assessments.

artifacts.name: Recovery and Response Metrics
artifacts.description: Documented RTO, RPO, MTTD and MTTR targets for critical systems, with the reports measuring actual performance against them.

artifacts.name: Continual Service Improvement Programme
artifacts.description: The documented continual service improvement programme with KPIs aligned to organisational goals, the register of improvement initiatives with status and benefits realised, and the reports showing service improvement outcomes.

artifacts.name: IT Strategy and Architecture Documentation
artifacts.description: The IT strategic plan aligned to business strategy, current-state and target-state architecture documentation, gap analysis reports with prioritised initiatives, and the roadmap and communication material through which the strategy is disseminated.

artifacts.name: Accountability, Performance and Awareness Records
artifacts.description: The accountability framework, performance evaluation criteria that include security responsibilities, incentive and reward documentation tied to control objectives, internal security communication procedures, awareness programme materials with attendance and completion records, and the whistleblower or anonymous reporting mechanism.

GOV-05.1.notes: 122 asks across 8 frameworks, dominated by NDMO restating the same KPI artifact once per data domain (12 separate specifications). Those are merged into one KPI dashboard artifact rather than kept as twelve near-identical asks.

artifacts.name: Risk Indicator Catalogue
artifacts.description: The cyber resilience indicator catalogue, the defined risk metrics and measurement methodology, the baseline and current measurements against them, the risk, compliance, incident, awareness, threat and project indicator records, and the fraud loss limits register with its threshold review records.

artifacts.name: Risk Reporting Methodology
artifacts.description: The methodology for risk reporting highlighting high-exposure systems, processes or infrastructure; the management approval of that methodology; the register capturing risk events, regulatory requirements and audit observations fed into it; the procedures defining how risks are monitored and reported at tactical, management and board levels; and the templates for periodic monthly, quarterly and annual risk reports.

artifacts.name: Risk Monitoring Dashboard
artifacts.description: The dashboard showing real-time or periodic risk metrics, the risk heat map or matrix, the technology risk dashboard and metrics reviewed, the security performance dashboards and reports, the current risk register evidencing ongoing monitoring and status updates, and the risk scoring and impact analysis records behind the figures.

artifacts.name: Management Information Reporting
artifacts.description: The management-approved procedures defining the format and contents of management information for the governance and risk framework, the technical specification of data sources, frequency, report templates and distribution list, the periodic management reports monitoring framework implementation, the samples of risk reports submitted to management highlighting high-exposure areas, and the minutes of senior management meetings reviewing the outputs.

artifacts.name: Board and Committee Oversight Records
artifacts.description: The board charter and composition documentation, the board independence declarations, the committee structure documentation, the technology governance committee charter, the board meeting minutes showing internal control oversight, the meeting minutes and attendance records, the board reporting packages on internal controls and security, the semi-annual board indicator dashboards, and the action item tracking and follow-up from those meetings.

artifacts.name: Cloud Oversight Committee Records
artifacts.description: The updated committee terms of reference explicitly including cloud outsourcing governance responsibilities covering service levels, indicators and incidents; the board or delegated authority approval of that amendment; the dashboard pack submitted to the committee showing provider performance and cloud risk indicators; and the committee minutes evidencing review of provider service levels, indicator performance and cloud incidents.

artifacts.name: Remedial Action Records
artifacts.description: The remedial action plans arising from indicator breaches and the threshold review records evidencing the breach was noticed and acted on rather than merely reported.

artifacts.name: Accountability and Incentive Records
artifacts.description: The accountability framework documentation, the performance evaluation criteria including security responsibilities, and the incentive and reward programme documentation tied to control objectives.

artifacts.name: Assurance Programme Records
artifacts.description: The internal audit plan and schedule, the continuous monitoring programme documentation, the security control testing results and reports, and the penetration testing and vulnerability assessment reports feeding the indicator set.

artifacts.name: Internal Communication Records
artifacts.description: The internal security communication procedures, the security awareness programme materials, and the whistleblower or anonymous reporting mechanism documentation providing an indicator channel outside the reporting line.

artifacts.name: Strategy Alignment Records
artifacts.description: The technology strategic plan aligned with business strategy, the current-state and target-state architecture documentation, the gap analysis reports with prioritised initiatives, and the strategy communication and roadmap presentations against which the indicators are read.

artifacts.name: AI Measurement Records
artifacts.description: The context documentation covering intended purposes, the validity and reliability demonstration with generalisability limitations documented, the documented evidence demonstrating the measurement outcomes, the stakeholder engagement and feedback log, and the periodic review records.

GOV-05.2.notes: 57 asks across 7 frameworks. The indicator catalogue, the dashboard and the governance body that reads it are three separable proofs; the last is the one that turns metrics into decisions and is kept distinct.

artifacts.name: Special Interest Group Register
artifacts.description: The list of memberships in information sharing and analysis centres, response teams, vendor security forums and professional bodies; the membership records in security groups; the records of memberships in industry response and sharing platforms; the membership evidence for industry threat exchange platforms; the records of national and international cooperation linkages and memberships; the information sharing community memberships; the trusted community membership documentation; and the membership invoices or certificates proving active membership for the current period. CSA CCM accepts configuration evidence in place of the documented special interest groups requirement.

artifacts.name: Information Sharing Agreements
artifacts.description: The memoranda of understanding or non-disclosure agreements signed with intelligence sharing partners, the threat intelligence sharing agreements, the information sharing agreements, the information sharing agreement or arrangement documentation, and the data protection compliance measures for the information shared under them.

artifacts.name: Information Exchange Records
artifacts.description: The log of threat intelligence received and shared with industry peers, the records of threat information exchanged with the industry platform, the shared threat indicator records, the indicators of compromise sharing records, the participation logs covering downloads, submissions and forum posts, the participation records in forums, the industry collaboration records, and the threat intelligence sharing platform participation records.

artifacts.name: Platform Integration Evidence
artifacts.description: The evidence of technical integration with industry sharing platforms through structured threat information feeds, and the threat intelligence subscriptions and feeds connected to them.

artifacts.name: Information Sharing Governance
artifacts.description: The information sharing governance framework, the dedicated platform documentation, the participation conditions documentation, and the public authority involvement protocols governing what may be shared and with whom.

artifacts.name: Response Team Liaison Records
artifacts.description: The records of liaison with organisational, sectoral and national response teams; the documented points of contact for that coordination; the coordination records with the sector regulator for cybersecurity information; and the priority information identification process determining what is escalated.

artifacts.name: Internal Dissemination Records
artifacts.description: The evidence that advisories received from special interest groups are disseminated to relevant internal teams, the sample threat intelligence reports distributed internally, and the procedures for gathering, analysing and sharing threat intelligence including participation in industry platforms.

artifacts.name: Conference and Forum Attendance
artifacts.description: The certificates or attendance logs from security conferences and specialist forums and the register of threat intelligence and best-practice sources maintained alongside them.

artifacts.name: Technology Watch Records
artifacts.description: The procedure for monitoring technological developments relevant to cyber risk management, the list of subscriptions, feeds and research memberships supporting it, the reports on emerging threats and new cyber risk management processes, and the change log of controls updated in response to those developments.

artifacts.name: Independent Expert Engagement
artifacts.description: The committee minutes documenting the decision to seek an independent expert opinion with its rationale, the engagement records and contracts for the experts engaged, and the reports or advisory memoranda received from them.

artifacts.name: Vulnerability Intelligence Records
artifacts.description: The inventory of vulnerability intelligence sources subscribed to, the documented risk ranking methodology aligned with industry sources, the documented vulnerability management procedure covering identification from those sources, and the tracking system records showing identification source, severity, owner and status.

artifacts.name: External Communication Records
artifacts.description: The customer communication procedures for security incidents, the external audit communication protocols, the public-facing security and privacy disclosures, and the service level agreements with security provisions governing what is communicated outward.

artifacts.name: Contact Policy and Review Records
artifacts.description: The approved contact policy and standard with its implementing procedure, the awareness communications informing personnel of it, and the periodic review records naming the reviewer.

GOV-07.notes: 58 asks across 11 frameworks. Membership, the exchange it carries and the internal dissemination of what arrives are three proofs; the last is the one most often absent and is kept separate. DORA Article 45's information-sharing governance is distinct from ordinary membership and stays apart.

artifacts.name: Context Analysis
artifacts.description: The context analysis document, the internal and external issue register, the environmental analysis worksheet capturing legal, regulatory, cultural and competitive factors, and the context documentation covering intended purposes.

artifacts.name: Interested Parties Register
artifacts.description: The interested parties register, the stakeholder analysis document, the legal and regulatory requirements log, and the contractual obligations inventory recording what each party requires of the organisation.

artifacts.name: Technology Strategy
artifacts.description: The comprehensive technology strategy document covering vision, mission, stakeholder map, business workflow and data processing; the board resolution approving it with effective and next-review dates; the board meeting minutes capturing the deliberations and approval; the presentation deck tabled at approval; the multi-year implementation roadmap breaking the strategy into initiatives with timelines, owners, budgets and indicators; the strategic plan aligned with business strategy; the current-state and target-state architecture documentation; the gap analysis reports with prioritised initiatives; and the strategy communication and roadmap presentations.

artifacts.name: Business Alignment Records
artifacts.description: The business relationship management framework documentation, the business requirements documentation with its prioritisation records, the alignment meeting minutes with their action items, and the service level agreements with the customer satisfaction reports measuring whether the alignment holds.

artifacts.name: AI Objectives Register
artifacts.description: The register of AI objectives at relevant functions and levels with measurability, requirements and monitoring frequency; the plan specifying what will be done, resources required, responsibility, completion dates and result-evaluation method; the dashboard tracking objective progress and measurement results; and the evidence of those objectives being communicated within the organisation.

artifacts.name: Governance Framework Records
artifacts.description: The technology management framework documentation and policies, the organisational structure charts with technology roles and responsibilities, the responsibility matrices for technology processes, and the capability maturity assessments with their improvement plans.

artifacts.name: Stakeholder Communication Records
artifacts.description: The stakeholder communication strategy and plans, the board and management reporting packages, the governance reporting templates and dashboards, and the stakeholder satisfaction survey results.

artifacts.name: AI Context Records
artifacts.description: The documented evidence demonstrating the context-mapping outcome, the implementation records and artifacts evidencing it within the AI estate, and the periodic review records.

artifacts.name: Data Governance Principles
artifacts.description: The approved data management and personal data protection strategy, the documented guiding principles specification with its compliance evidence, the data security control evidence including access controls, and the privacy artifacts.

GOV-08.notes: 40 asks across 6 frameworks. Context analysis, interested parties and the strategy that follows from both are three proofs; ISO 22301 clause 4 and COBIT's strategy alignment answer the same question from different angles and are kept apart.

artifacts.name: Security Objectives Documentation
artifacts.description: The documented security and operational objectives, the objective-setting methodology documentation, the risk tolerance statements, the compliance requirements inventory, the information security policy document with its policy objectives documentation and scope definition, and the regulatory compliance mapping behind them.

artifacts.name: Policy to Objectives Alignment
artifacts.description: The matrix mapping information security policies to organisational and security objectives and to regulator guidance, and the register of applicable regulator frameworks and guidelines reflected in policy.

artifacts.name: AI Objectives Register
artifacts.description: The register of AI objectives at relevant functions and levels with measurability, requirements and monitoring frequency; the plan specifying what will be done, resources required, responsibility, completion dates and result-evaluation method; the dashboard tracking objective progress and measurement results; and the evidence of those objectives being communicated within the organisation.

artifacts.name: Leadership Commitment Records
artifacts.description: The signed top-management statement of commitment to the management system, its policy and objectives; the minutes of executive meetings where performance, decisions and continual improvement are discussed; the log of internal communications by top management; and the budget and resource allocations provisioned for the management system.

artifacts.name: Control Selection Methodology
artifacts.description: The consistent methodology for selecting and specifying security controls across systems, the management approval of that methodology, the baseline control catalogue referenced during selection, and the decision records evidencing the methodology was applied for each system.

artifacts.name: Minimum Baseline Security Standard
artifacts.description: The approved minimum baseline security controls standard covering access, network, operating system and application layers; the access rights management procedure covering the user lifecycle; the electronic authentication standard; the application-level access control configuration; the operating system access control configuration; the network access control configuration; the remote access control configuration for privileged access; and the mapping demonstrating those controls derive from risk assessment findings.

artifacts.name: Operational Planning and Control
artifacts.description: The catalogue of operational processes with criteria, control points and ownership; the register of externally provided processes, products and services with their associated controls; the records of planned changes with reviews of the consequences of unintended ones; and the indicators and audit notes monitoring effectiveness of implemented controls with the corrective actions arising.

artifacts.name: Risk Treatment Records
artifacts.description: The risk management plan with its mitigation strategies, the risk treatment decisions with their rationale, the residual risk acceptance documentation, and the security measure implementation evidence.

artifacts.name: Governance Framework Records
artifacts.description: The technology management framework documentation and policies, the organisational structure charts with technology roles and responsibilities, the responsibility matrices for technology processes, and the capability maturity assessments with their improvement plans.

artifacts.name: Internal Communication Records
artifacts.description: The board reporting packages on internal controls and security, the internal security communication procedures, the security awareness programme materials, and the whistleblower or anonymous reporting mechanism documentation.

artifacts.name: Data Governance Principles
artifacts.description: The approved data management and personal data protection strategy, the documented guiding principles specification with its compliance evidence, the data security control evidence including access controls, and the privacy artifacts.

GOV-09.notes: 50 asks across 9 frameworks. Overlaps GOV-15.1 on control selection; what is distinct here is the objective the control is selected to meet, so the objective register and its measurement stay separate from the control baseline.

artifacts.name: Data Catalog
artifacts.description: The metadata repository or data catalog export, the documented data catalog plan specification with its compliance evidence, the register or inventory evidencing that plan with a named owner, and the approved data management and personal data protection strategy behind it.

artifacts.name: Catalog Tooling Records
artifacts.description: The approved policy or standard covering the automated cataloguing tool, the documented specification with its compliance evidence, and the register or inventory evidencing the tool with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Data Identification Records
artifacts.description: The documented data identification specification with its compliance evidence, the documented procedures and process workflows implementing it, and the register or inventory evidencing identification with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Data Register
artifacts.description: The documented data register specification with its compliance evidence, the documented procedures and process workflows implementing it, the register or inventory evidencing it with a named owner, the compliance audit reports and assessment records, and the formal approval and socialisation records covering committee minutes, sign-off and workshops.

artifacts.name: Classification Metadata Records
artifacts.description: The documented data classification metadata specification with its compliance evidence, the documented procedures and process workflows implementing it, the data classification scheme and labelled dataset register, and the register or inventory evidencing classification metadata with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Quality Metadata Records
artifacts.description: The documented data quality metadata specification with its compliance evidence, the documented procedures and process workflows implementing it, the data quality profiling reports, the performance metrics dashboard with targets, measurements and review records, and the register or inventory evidencing quality metadata with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Metadata Architecture
artifacts.description: The documented metadata architecture specification with its compliance evidence, the data architecture artifacts covering data models, entity relationship diagrams and design documentation, and the register or inventory evidencing the architecture with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Data Source Prioritisation
artifacts.description: The documented data sources prioritisation specification with its compliance evidence, the implementation evidence demonstrating the outcome, the register or inventory evidencing prioritisation with a named owner, and the periodic review records naming reviewer, date and corrective actions.

artifacts.name: Content Metadata Publishing
artifacts.description: The documented document and content metadata publishing specification with its compliance evidence, the documented procedures behind it, and the register or inventory evidencing publishing with a named owner.

artifacts.name: Catalog Governance and Protection
artifacts.description: The organisational artifacts covering role mandates, responsibility matrices, job descriptions and committee charters; the data security control evidence including access controls over the catalogue; and the privacy artifacts.

GOV-10.1.notes: 47 asks from NDMO alone, spread across nine specifications. They collapse into the catalogue itself, the metadata it holds, and the governance around both — the per-specification compliance packs are grouped rather than kept as nine near-identical documents.

artifacts.name: Leadership Commitment Records
artifacts.description: The signed top-management statement of commitment to the management system, its policy and objectives, aligned with strategic direction; the minutes of executive meetings where performance, decisions and continual improvement are discussed; the log of internal communications by top management on the importance of the management system; and the budget and resource allocations of finance, people and infrastructure provisioned for it.

artifacts.name: Operational Planning and Control
artifacts.description: The operational planning documentation, the process criteria and controls, the catalogue of operational processes with criteria, control points and ownership, and the register of externally provided processes, products and services with their associated controls.

artifacts.name: Change Control Records
artifacts.description: The change management policy and procedures, the change advisory board records, the change testing and approval documentation, the emergency change procedures, and the records of planned changes with reviews of the consequences of unintended ones and their mitigation actions.

artifacts.name: Control Effectiveness Monitoring
artifacts.description: The performance and risk indicators and audit notes monitoring effectiveness of implemented controls with the corrective actions arising, the cybersecurity metrics dashboard, the security audit reports and findings, the penetration testing reports, and the management body briefing records on cybersecurity effectiveness.

artifacts.name: Control Activities Inventory
artifacts.description: The control activities inventory mapped to the risks they address, the control design documentation, the risk-control mapping matrix, and the segregation of duties matrix with its analysis.

artifacts.name: Risk Management Domain Records
artifacts.description: The information security policy approved by the management body, the risk assessment methodology documentation, the risk treatment plan with prioritised actions, and the annual risk assessment review records.

artifacts.name: Incident Handling Domain Records
artifacts.description: The incident response plan with defined roles and escalation procedures, the incident classification and severity framework, the incident handling playbooks for common scenarios, and the incident log with the post-incident review records.

artifacts.name: Continuity Domain Records
artifacts.description: The business continuity plan covering critical services, the disaster recovery plan with defined recovery objectives, the backup management policy with its testing records, and the crisis management framework and communication plan.

artifacts.name: Supply Chain Domain Records
artifacts.description: The supply chain security policy, the contractual security requirements for suppliers, the supplier risk assessment records, and the supplier security monitoring and audit reports.

artifacts.name: Development and Acquisition Domain Records
artifacts.description: The secure development lifecycle documentation and procedures, the secure procurement policy with security requirements written into tender documents, the security testing results for systems before deployment, and the vulnerability handling and disclosure policy.

artifacts.name: Cyber Hygiene and Training Domain Records
artifacts.description: The cyber hygiene policy and practices documentation, the cybersecurity training programme and curriculum, the training attendance and completion records, and the phishing simulation and awareness exercise results.

artifacts.name: Cryptography Domain Records
artifacts.description: The cryptography and encryption policy, the encryption implementation inventory covering data at rest and in transit, the key management procedures with custodian records, and the cryptographic algorithm and protocol review records.

artifacts.name: Access and Asset Domain Records
artifacts.description: The access control policy with least privilege requirements, the access review and recertification records, the asset inventory and classification records, and the human resources security policy covering the employment lifecycle.

artifacts.name: Authentication and Communications Domain Records
artifacts.description: The multi-factor authentication implementation policy with its deployment records, the coverage assessment for critical systems, the secured communications solution documentation, and the emergency communication system testing records.

artifacts.name: Framework Integration Records
artifacts.description: The documentation integrating the technology risk framework with the enterprise risk framework and the records of regular framework reviews keeping that integration current.

GOV-15.notes: 61 asks across 6 frameworks. NIS2 Article 21(2) contributes ten sub-paragraphs naming ten different domains; these stay as domain artifacts rather than collapsing into one, because an assessor tests each sub-paragraph separately.

artifacts.name: Control Selection Methodology
artifacts.description: The consistent methodology for selecting and specifying security controls across systems, with its management approval and the baseline control catalogue referenced during selection.

artifacts.name: Control Selection Decision Records
artifacts.description: The decision records evidencing the methodology was applied for each system, and the mapping demonstrating the selected controls derive from risk assessment findings rather than from a generic list.

artifacts.name: Statement of Applicability
artifacts.description: The statement of applicability listing the selected controls with the justification for including or excluding each, and the register of implemented controls mapped to framework requirements and applicable standards.

artifacts.name: Minimum Baseline Security Standard
artifacts.description: The approved minimum baseline security controls standard covering access, network, operating system and application layers, with the access rights management procedure, the electronic authentication standard, and the configuration evidence for application, operating system, network and remote access controls implementing it.

artifacts.name: Control Activities Inventory
artifacts.description: The control activities inventory mapped to the risks they address, the control design documentation, the risk-control mapping matrix, and the segregation of duties matrix with its analysis.

artifacts.name: Domain Control Set
artifacts.description: The controls selected across each required domain: information security policy approved by the management body; risk assessment methodology and treatment plan; incident handling with classification, playbooks, response plan and review; continuity, backup, disaster recovery and crisis management; supply chain security policy with supplier assessments; secure development, procurement and vulnerability handling; effectiveness metrics, audits and penetration testing; cyber hygiene and training; cryptography and key management; access control with least privilege, asset classification and human resources security; and multi-factor authentication with secured communications.

artifacts.name: Control Effectiveness Monitoring
artifacts.description: The reports from internal assessments of control effectiveness, the implementation evidence pack of configurations, screenshots and logs, and the records monitoring whether the selected controls are working with the corrective actions taken where they are not.

artifacts.name: Operational Planning Records
artifacts.description: The operational planning documentation, the process criteria and controls, the catalogue of operational processes with criteria, control points and ownership, and the change control records covering planned changes and the review of unintended ones.

artifacts.name: External Provider Control Register
artifacts.description: The register of externally provided processes, products and services relevant to the management system with the controls associated with each.

GOV-15.1.notes: 67 asks across 6 frameworks. Overlaps GOV-15.2; what is distinct here is the selection decision — the methodology, the baseline catalogue and the record of why each control was chosen — rather than the evidence that the selected controls operate.

artifacts.name: Implemented Controls Register
artifacts.description: The register of implemented controls mapped to framework requirements and applicable standards, the statement of applicability, and the risk-to-control mapping showing each control derives from an assessed risk rather than from a checklist.

artifacts.name: Control Implementation Evidence
artifacts.description: The evidence pack of configurations, screenshots and logs demonstrating deployment of the key controls, and the security measure implementation evidence supporting it.

artifacts.name: Control Effectiveness Monitoring
artifacts.description: The reports from internal assessments of control effectiveness, and the records — indicators, audit notes — monitoring whether implemented controls are working, with the corrective actions taken where they are not.

artifacts.name: Control Activities Inventory
artifacts.description: The control activities inventory mapped to the risks they address, the control design documentation, the risk-control mapping matrix, and the segregation of duties matrix with its analysis.

artifacts.name: Minimum Baseline Security Standard
artifacts.description: The approved minimum baseline security controls standard covering access, network, operating system and application layers, with the access rights management procedure, the electronic authentication standard, and the configuration evidence for application, operating system, network and remote access controls implementing it.

artifacts.name: Domain Control Set
artifacts.description: The implemented controls across each required domain: information security policy approved by the management body; risk assessment methodology and treatment plan; incident handling with classification, playbooks, response plan and post-incident review; continuity, backup, disaster recovery and crisis management; supply chain security policy with supplier assessments and monitoring; secure development, procurement and vulnerability handling; effectiveness metrics, audits and penetration testing; cyber hygiene and training; cryptography and key management; access control with least privilege, asset classification and human resources security; and multi-factor authentication with secured communications. NIS2 requires all of these under one obligation.

artifacts.name: Risk Treatment and Residual Acceptance
artifacts.description: The risk management plan with mitigation strategies, the risk treatment decisions with their rationale, and the residual risk acceptance documentation signed by a named owner.

artifacts.name: Control Implementation Prioritisation
artifacts.description: The risk and criticality-based control implementation plan with management or regulator approval, and the records prioritising resources to the assets that essential services depend on.

artifacts.name: Operational Planning Records
artifacts.description: The operational planning documentation, the process criteria and controls, the catalogue of operational processes with criteria, control points and ownership, and the change control records covering planned changes and the review of unintended ones with their mitigation.

artifacts.name: External Provider Control Register
artifacts.description: The register of externally provided processes, products and services relevant to the management system with the controls associated with each.

GOV-15.2.notes: 69 asks across 8 frameworks, dominated by NIS2 Article 21(2) which enumerates ten control domains as one requirement. Those are merged into a domain control set rather than kept as ten artifacts, because the framework tests them as a single implementation obligation.

artifacts.name: Periodic Regulatory Compliance Reports
artifacts.description: The annual compliance reports submitted to the regulator, the regulator compliance reporting framework, the annual standards compliance report, the annual continuity plan submission with its management approval, the continuity results summary, the board-signed action plans submitted to the regulator, the material gap register, and the mitigation measures evidence accompanying them.

artifacts.name: Entity Registration Records
artifacts.description: The entity registration confirmation from the competent authority, the address range and service scope documentation submitted with it, the registration information accuracy verification records, and the change notification records with their timestamps.

artifacts.name: Material Change Notification
artifacts.description: The procedure requiring notification of material changes to the sector regulator and response team within the prescribed period and the records and correspondence of those notifications with timestamps.

artifacts.name: Offshore Outsourcing Submission
artifacts.description: The register distinguishing material from non-material workloads with the materiality criteria and classification rationale, the detailed risk assessment covering systemic, institution-specific, legal and strategic risks, the internal committee or board approval records authorising the pre-placement submission, the submission package covering every required area, and the signed regulatory approval letter authorising outsourcing of the material workload.

artifacts.name: Pre-Placement Notification Records
artifacts.description: The standard submission template covering provider name and parent company, activities and data description; the register tracking material workloads placed with providers, submission date, placement date and lead-time compliance; the copies of actual submissions made to the regulator; the receipt acknowledgments confirming the notification was received; the internal sign-off records authorising submission and placement; the corporate ownership diagram identifying the contracting entity and its parent; and the extract from the data inventory showing classification and sensitivity of the datasets to be hosted.

artifacts.name: Board Accountability Records
artifacts.description: The board resolution acknowledging ultimate accountability for cloud-hosted information assets, the internal audit certification to the board confirming legal and regulatory compliance of the arrangements, the consolidated dossier of arrangements maintained in readiness for submission on demand, the log of information requests received from the regulator with response dates and contents submitted, and the documented readiness note showing capability to shift workloads to a designated onshore community facility.

artifacts.name: Privacy Reporting Records
artifacts.description: The privacy notice published to data subjects with its version history, the consent records with opt-out tracking and data subject request logs, the awareness communications, and the periodic review records naming the reviewer. HITRUST requires the approved privacy protection reporting policy and standard with its implementing procedure.

artifacts.name: Data Governance Communications
artifacts.description: The approved data management and personal data protection strategy, the approved communications policy or standard with its documented specification and compliance evidence, the documented procedures and process workflows implementing it, the training and awareness records covering curriculum, attendance, completion and schedule, and the compliance audit reports and assessment records.

GOV-17.notes: 43 asks across 6 frameworks. Every framework here names a different recipient and a different filing; the artifacts are grouped by regulator rather than by report type because the submission packages are not interchangeable.

artifacts.name: Human Resources Security Policy
artifacts.description: The approved policy covering the employment lifecycle with its review and approval records, the human resources policies carrying information security clauses, the personnel security policy and procedures, and the roles and responsibilities matrix. NIS2 requires the policy to span the full lifecycle from hire to exit.

artifacts.name: Personnel Screening Records
artifacts.description: The documented screening procedure for roles with access to regulated environments, the background check records covering criminal history, employment verification and references, the documentation of jurisdictional legal constraints affecting screening scope, the agreement with the screening provider, and the background verification process documentation. CSA CCM accepts configuration evidence in place of the documented screening policy.

artifacts.name: Employment Terms with Security Clauses
artifacts.description: The sample contract showing security and confidentiality clauses in the terms of employment, the signed non-disclosure agreements, the third-party and contractor agreements citing information security responsibilities, and the policy acknowledgement records from employees and third parties.

artifacts.name: Acceptable Use Policy and Enforcement
artifacts.description: The documented acceptable use policy for end-user technologies including the explicit approval requirement and the list of acceptable uses, the distribution and acknowledgment records, and the endpoint or device management configuration enforcing it technically.

artifacts.name: New Joiner Security Briefing Records
artifacts.description: The induction attendance or checklist signed by new hires confirming a security briefing before access is granted, and the hiring and onboarding procedures that require it.

artifacts.name: Workforce Clearance and Authorisation
artifacts.description: The workforce clearance procedures, the access authorisation procedures, the supervisor approval records, and the identity verification procedures applied before access is granted.

artifacts.name: Hiring Policy and Standard Operating Procedures
artifacts.description: The board or management-approved hiring policy governing recruitment with selection criteria, vetting and onboarding; the standard operating procedures implementing it; the training policy; and the audit reports on adherence to the hiring and training policies.

artifacts.name: Competence and Training Records
artifacts.description: The competency framework and requirements, the staffing plans and skills inventory, the competency assessment records, the training and development programmes with their completion records, the performance evaluation records, and the succession planning documentation for key roles.

artifacts.name: AI Competence Records
artifacts.description: The competence matrix mapping AI-related roles to required education, training, experience and skill level; the updated job descriptions specifying those requirements; the training records; and the competence evaluation records assessing whether the actions taken were effective.

artifacts.name: Code of Conduct and Governance Records
artifacts.description: The code of conduct or ethics policy with the employee acknowledgment records, the board minutes demonstrating oversight, and the disciplinary action records for conduct violations.

artifacts.name: Authentication Controls for Workforce
artifacts.description: The authentication policy and procedures, the authentication mechanism documentation, and the multi-factor implementation evidence covering workforce access.

artifacts.name: Access Control and Asset Classification
artifacts.description: The access control policy with least privilege requirements, the access review and recertification records, and the asset inventory and classification records that determine what each role may reach.

artifacts.name: Management Commitment Records
artifacts.description: The signed leadership statement committing to enforce security policies and provide resources, the management review minutes with directives to staff, and the guidance issued to line managers on enforcing policy in their teams.

artifacts.name: Regulated Data on Public Systems
artifacts.description: The documented requirement or configuration evidence controlling regulated data on publicly accessible systems, with the records demonstrating it is implemented and operating, covering what personnel may post.

artifacts.name: AI Governance Awareness Records
artifacts.description: The approved organisational policies and procedures covering AI, the context documentation covering intended purposes, the AI impact assessment, the safety evaluation records including fail-safe behaviour, and the documented evidence of the outcome.

HRS-01.notes: 66 asks across 15 frameworks. Screening, employment terms and ongoing competence are separated because they attach to different points in the employment lifecycle and are evidenced by different functions.

artifacts.name: Cybersecurity Roles & Responsibilities Definition Document
artifacts.description: The single approved document defining cybersecurity and data privacy roles and responsibilities across the organization, with a section for each control area PCI DSS enumerates (network security controls, logging, security testing, configuration, data protection, transmission security, anti-malware, development, access control, authentication, physical access) plus governance, AI and critical-infrastructure roles where applicable. Must be formally approved and show each responsibility has a named owner rather than an unassigned function.

artifacts.name: RACI / Responsibility Assignment Matrix
artifacts.description: The responsibility assignment matrix mapping every security, privacy, AI, continuity and problem-management activity to responsible, accountable, consulted and informed parties. PISF 2026 and SBP ETGRMF additionally require a review log showing the matrix is periodically revisited and kept aligned to the current organization.

artifacts.name: Job Descriptions & Competence / Training Records
artifacts.description: Position descriptions for security-relevant roles with the cybersecurity and privacy duties written into them, backed by the competency framework or skills matrix for those roles and the training, certification and competence-evaluation records showing incumbents meet it. QCB expects sample job descriptions containing explicit information security sections.

artifacts.name: Organisational Chart & Governance Structure Documentation
artifacts.description: Current organisation chart showing reporting lines and where the security, privacy, AI and business continuity functions sit, including the independence of the security function, plus the documented governance responsibility model showing how responsibility is shared with cloud and service providers.

artifacts.name: Appointment Letters & Role Communication Records
artifacts.description: Formal appointment letters or terms of reference for named security, privacy, AI and continuity role holders, and evidence the assignments were communicated to the organization — announcements, intranet publication, internal communication procedures, and the confidential/whistleblower reporting channel personnel are told to use.

artifacts.name: Segregation of Duties Matrix & Process Control Evidence
artifacts.description: The segregation of duties matrix identifying incompatible responsibilities and the compensating controls where separation is not achievable, the approved SoD policy and procedure, role-dedication and conflict-of-interest review records, and the business process control evidence demonstrating it operates: privilege records, processing validation and integrity checks, and error/exception handling with corrective action.

artifacts.name: Personnel Acknowledgement, Rules of Behaviour & Custodian Registers
artifacts.description: Signed acknowledgements that individuals accept their assigned security responsibilities and the rules of behaviour, awareness evidence showing responsibilities were communicated, signed NDAs, and the key custodian register with its signed custodian acknowledgement forms.

artifacts.name: Position Categorization, Screening & Clearance Records
artifacts.description: The risk categorization of positions (including application developer, cybersecurity, data privacy and regulated-data-handling roles), the criteria that set the access level appropriate to each, the workforce clearance procedure, and the completed background/screening records for people placed in those positions.

artifacts.name: Authorized Personnel & Emergency Access Lists
artifacts.description: Current lists of personnel authorised for each sensitive function or facility, the authorisation matrix approved by top management, the emergency-access personnel list with the procedure governing emergency facility access, emergency access log records, and the payment brand/acquirer contact list for regulated escalation.

artifacts.name: Onboarding Provisioning Checklist & Access Rights Records
artifacts.description: The onboarding checklist showing what each new role is granted and by whom, plus the technical access control policy, access rights management procedure, system access configurations and the access control matrix and provisioning/modification records that evidence roles were translated into actual entitlements.

artifacts.name: Incident Response Plan with Assigned Roles
artifacts.description: The incident response plan showing roles and responsibilities assigned for detection, escalation and notification, with the legal and regulatory reporting map naming who notifies whom and within what deadline. Protect and distribute it as controlled documentation.

artifacts.name: Board & Committee Oversight Records
artifacts.description: Board charter and composition, independence declarations, committee structure (audit, risk, security), and minutes or approval records evidencing top management reviewed and approved the assignment of security responsibilities and received reporting on internal control performance.

artifacts.name: Performance Objectives & Role Review Records
artifacts.description: Evidence that assigned responsibilities are held to account: performance review templates carrying information security objectives, outcome-based performance metrics for the roles, AI management system performance reporting, and the periodic role review records confirming assignments remain appropriate.

artifacts.name: HR Policies & Third-Party Agreements Carrying Security Responsibilities
artifacts.description: HR policies containing information security clauses, and contractor, third-party and service agreements that assign security responsibilities to external parties — with the security clauses, SLAs and right-to-audit provisions HITRUST requires, plus the third-party risk assessment and ongoing monitoring records.

artifacts.name: BCMS Roles & Recovery Resource Requirements
artifacts.description: The business continuity management roles and responsibilities set, together with the resource requirements analysis, alternate site specifications and technology recovery requirements that define what each continuity role must be able to call on.

artifacts.name: Technical Control Implementation Evidence Supporting Assigned Roles
artifacts.description: Operating evidence that the assigned responsibilities are actually exercised in the environment: documented security measures and risk assessments, encryption and key-management implementation for the cryptographic custodian roles, residual risk acceptance records signed by the accountable owner, and network architecture diagrams and device configuration baselines with ruleset review records.

HRS-03.notes: 149 entries reduce to 16. PCI DSS alone contributes 32 near-identical 'roles & responsibilities document + RACI matrix' pairs across its twelve requirement areas — those are one document and one matrix with twelve sections, not 32 artifacts. Only a Rippling HR collector is configured, so job descriptions and org structure are hybrid at best; everything else is manual.

artifacts.name: Security Roles and Responsibilities Documentation
artifacts.description: The documented roles and responsibilities for performing the activities in each security domain — network security controls, secure configuration, data protection, transmission security, anti-malware, secure development, access control, authentication, physical access, logging, security testing and the overall programme — with the RACI matrix mapping named individuals or teams to each activity. PCI DSS requires both the document and the matrix per requirement area; HITRUST requires the approved roles-and-responsibilities standard with its implementing procedure.

artifacts.name: Personnel Acknowledgment Records
artifacts.description: The acknowledgment records evidencing personnel understand the responsibilities assigned to them and the security policies that govern them, the acceptable usage acknowledgements, and the signed rules acknowledgements for controlled areas.

artifacts.name: Role Definitions and Job Descriptions
artifacts.description: The job descriptions, role definitions and responsibility matrices, the security role assignments, and the sections of the information security policy that define security roles and responsibilities.

artifacts.name: Role Orientation Records
artifacts.description: The role orientation documentation, the security briefing records, the access request forms with manager sign-off, and the pre-access training records evidencing awareness before access is granted.

artifacts.name: Security Awareness Training Records
artifacts.description: The approved awareness training curriculum covering threats and vulnerabilities, the learning management system completion records evidencing training on hire and at least annually, the phishing simulation results with remediation activity, and the acknowledgment records confirming understanding.

artifacts.name: Secure Area Awareness Records
artifacts.description: The secure area orientation and training records, the posters and communications on discussion etiquette in areas where sensitive information is handled, and the signed rules acknowledgements for those areas.

artifacts.name: User Responsibility Records
artifacts.description: The documented compliance user responsibility with the records demonstrating it operates in the environment covered, and the acceptable usage awareness material supporting it.

artifacts.name: AI Awareness Programme Records
artifacts.description: The documented AI awareness programme covering the AI policy, each person's contribution and the implications of non-conformance; the communication artifacts used; and the attendance and completion records across the workforce.

artifacts.name: AI Governance Awareness Records
artifacts.description: The approved organisational policies and procedures covering AI, the context documentation covering intended purposes, the AI impact assessment, the safety evaluation records including fail-safe behaviour, and the documented evidence of the outcome.

artifacts.name: Third-Party Responsibility Records
artifacts.description: The third-party agreements with security clauses, service levels and right-to-audit, and the third-party risk assessment and monitoring records, extending the responsibility framework to provider personnel.

artifacts.name: Awareness Communications
artifacts.description: The awareness communications informing personnel of their assigned roles and responsibilities and the obligations that attach to them.

HRS-03.1.notes: 69 asks across 8 frameworks. PCI DSS contributes a roles-and-responsibilities document plus a RACI matrix for each of its twelve requirement areas; those are merged into one domain roles artifact rather than twenty-four separate ones, since an assessor asks for the set.

artifacts.name: Competence Requirements Matrix
artifacts.description: The matrix mapping security-related roles to required education, training, experience and skill level, the role-based skill matrix measured against current staff, and the skills inventory with its gap analysis. ISO 42001 requires the matrix to cover AI-related roles specifically; SBP ETGRMF requires competencies for IT governance, service delivery, information security and risk management.

artifacts.name: Job Descriptions and Position Profiles
artifacts.description: The current job descriptions specifying required expertise, authorities and responsibilities for each security-related role, with the organisation chart and reporting lines, the RACI matrix for key security functions, and the segregation of duties matrix showing no role combination creates a conflict.

artifacts.name: Qualification and Certification Records
artifacts.description: The certifications and curricula vitae of post-holders, the register of professional certifications with renewal dates, the staffing register recording full-time status and experience for function leads and critical roles, and the deployment orders confirming full-time assignment where required.

artifacts.name: Competence Evaluation Records
artifacts.description: The records evaluating whether the competence actions were effective — assessments, performance reviews, recertifications — and the individual development plans addressing identified gaps.

artifacts.name: Secure Coding Training Records
artifacts.description: The approved secure coding curriculum covering the technologies actually in use, the completion records evidencing training at least annually for developers of bespoke software, the acknowledgment or certificate records, and the developer competency assessment results.

artifacts.name: Role-Based Training Plan and Records
artifacts.description: The annual training plan, the matrix mapping job roles to mandatory modules and refresher cadence, the learning management system completion records, and the post-training assessments demonstrating effectiveness rather than attendance.

artifacts.name: Background and Knowledge Verification Records
artifacts.description: The records of verifying appropriate knowledge and background through assessment or pre-hire screening, the screening criteria documentation, the position risk designation records, and the periodic review of those designations.

artifacts.name: Board and Committee Composition Records
artifacts.description: The board charter and composition documentation, independence declarations, minutes showing internal control oversight, committee structure documentation, the security committee charter with member qualifications, the coordination procedures and the meeting minutes.

artifacts.name: Board Skills Oversight Report
artifacts.description: The report tabled at the board on the adequacy and currency of technology skills across the organisation, evidencing competence is governed rather than only administered.

artifacts.name: Performance and Accountability Records
artifacts.description: The accountability framework, performance evaluation criteria including security responsibilities, performance appraisal records, incentive and reward documentation tied to control objectives, and the security KPI dashboards reported against them.

artifacts.name: Policy Communication and Acknowledgement
artifacts.description: The information security policy library, the policy review and approval records, the exception management process, the standard operating procedures for key controls, and the communications to employees on policy changes with their acknowledgements.

artifacts.name: IT Management Framework and Structure
artifacts.description: The IT management framework documentation and policies, the organisational structure charts with IT roles, the RACI matrices for IT processes, the capability maturity assessments with improvement plans, and the competency framework defining what each capability requires.
